profile.headline: Software Developer at Informatics Research Institute, University of Louisiana, Lafayette
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 8+ years building production systems in healthcare, financial/tax, and education. Expertise and interest span three areas: software development, data pipelines, and AI/ML engineering. 

Holds an MS in Systems Science (Computer Science) and a Master's in Analytics, with graduate research experience in High Performance Computing  and Nutrition Science. Recently involved in AI/RAG and Data Visualization training as part of a summer program, and continues to mentor student research project. 

Software & systems

C#/.NET (Core), Python (Django, FastAPI), REST. Frontend in Next.js and React. Real-time with SignalR, Redis, Kafka, MSMQ. Azure, Docker, Azure DevOps for deployment

Data engineering 

SQL Server (T-SQL, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS), PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Supabase. ETL, warehousing, migration, query tuning. Power BI, Tableau, and Python analysis (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, GeoPandas) for the analytical side. 

AI/ML 

LLM integration with OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude. Agentic systems with tool calling, memory, and RAG (embeddings, vector search, reranking). MCP/A2A patterns, evaluation frameworks (dataset management, recall, LLM-as-judge), and tracing. Prior research on multimodal models (AVMNIST). Use Claude Code regularly for prototyping. 

As an avocation, exploring iOS app development and on-device ML — deploying models to iPhone for vertical, domain-specific use cases. Stays involved locally through Acadiana Software Developers and DEF CON Group Acadiana.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Develop and maintain the .NET Medicaid Participant Services System; build controller APIs, repositories, database schema, MVC Razor views (Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery), and View Models for Plan of Care, Appeals, budget, and scheduling modules.
● Architect the legacy .NET to .NET Core migration on Clean Architecture using EF Core scaffolding, Power Tools, and Dapper for code-first development and SQL version control; standardize APIs across legacy and new code; build reusable JavaScript paging/search components adopted as the system-wide UI template.
● Own database development — data modeling, schema design, stored procedures, functions, triggers — and tune queries via SSMS execution plans and SQL Server Profiler.
● Author SQL scripts and SSIS packages for ETL automation; handle production web and database deployments, remote debugging, and performance troubleshooting.
● Enhance the .NET Emergency Employee Directory for employee entry, assignment, and retrieval; develop SSRS reports and contact-data export to the enterprise Rave Alert system.
● Conduct supply-demand analysis for the Louisiana Governor's Healthcare Workforce Taskforce, with recommendations adopted into state policy proposals; build Python dashboards (Plotly, Pandas, NumPy), heat maps, and GIS visualizations (GeoPandas/Folium) of workforce gaps. Use React to visualize  heat map.
● Architect a Django REST application visualizing career pathways on a Neo4j graph database; integrate an OpenAI chatbot for personalized career guidance.
● Build a vectorless RAG pipeline (Python, Google Custom Search API, BeautifulSoup) automating scholarship collection, with OpenAI/Gemini prompt engineering structuring results.
● Lead migration of dietary data into a relational format and caseload data into the transactional system; set up automations and monitoring.
● Architect a .NET solution moving healthcare documents from a third-party IBM system to SQL Server via web services, plus a .NET Core search/download UI.

projects.title: Application of Rule Learning to Stock Market Analysis (MS Project)
projects.description:
MS Systems Science (Computer Science)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
               
Title of Project: Application of Rule Learning to Stock Market Analysis 

Synopsis: This project implements a web based database application that allows users to predict the current close price of a chosen stock and its next day close price by extracting association rules. For each stock included in the prototype system, the close prices of two of its competitors and two other stock market sentiment indicators are used to deduce association rules. These rules are used to obtain directional movement and value prediction for the next day close price. The association rules extracted are also applied to a validation period that follows the specified training period and the prediction efficacy is assessed using misclassification rate and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and these metrics are reported back to users along with the prediction results. 

Software Used: SQL Server, SAS
Predictive Models Employed:  Association Rule Mining, Neural Networks, Regression, Decision Trees

projects.title: A Framework for Evaluating Category Page Performance of Pay Per Click (PPC)  Advertisements (MS Project)
projects.description:
MS Analytics 
                      
Title of Project: A Framework for Evaluating Category Page Performance of Pay Per Click (PPC)  Advertisements 

Synopsis:  The current Pay Per Click (PPC) advertising tools developed by Google provides only limited support for advertisers to analyze PPC advertisement performance at the category page level. A data warehouse based system is designed and implemented that enables advertisers, especially online retailers to obtain custom performance reports on category pages and also allow them to leverage the built-in analytics support of this system to optimize category page advertising performance. A set of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and diagnostic metrics are proposed that will allow online marketers to effectively assess advertisement performance at the category page level. Predictive models are also developed to identify the KPIs that are statistically significant in determining the Average Ad Quality Score for the category page. 

Softwares Used: SQL Server, VB Script, Java, SAS, Google Analytics and AdWords, Excel 
Predictive Models Employed:   Neural Networks, Regression, Decision Trees
